intro.text: A Hallandren god who Returned as a two-year-old and now looks like a sturdy boy of about thirteen, though he speaks and acts like an adult. He holds the Commands for ten thousand Lifeless, a quarter of the army.

items.text: Frustrated by how little say he has in the court during peacetime, Hopefinder offers Blushweaver the Commands for his Lifeless if she will give him her vote on social matters. To everyone's surprise she agrees, and he tells her the phrase, a line from a famous Hallandren poem.

appearance.text: He Returned some eleven years ago, after dying at two, and looks like an unusually strong thirteen-year-old. His voice and bearing grew up much faster, so that Lightsong thinks of a boy imitating his father. His colours are violet and silver; though he looks the youngest, he is the fifth oldest god at court.

personality.text: Formal and serious despite his looks, he is unmoved by Blushweaver's flirting and seems truly to care about his petitioners, admitting he has thought of giving up his divine Breath to heal someone. He wants real influence over the government and keeps himself well informed about the palace and the world outside the city.
